documents.title: Conservation report
documents.text:
Conservation report: Ardith Fragments (fictional, authored test material).
Throughout the documents of this review, the Manuscript means Ardith Fragments. Ardith Fragments had binding date (CE) of 1595 in FY2024. For Ardith Fragments, illuminated initials in FY2025 was 185 (pro forma (including the planned acquisition) basis). Insured value at Ardith Fragments stood at $7.7m (reported basis). Ardith Fragments had share of palimpsest leaves of 29.4% in FY2024.
